historicalFinding.scenario: first migration-ledger adoption regrants a revoked administrator
historicalFinding.resolution: Activation verifies schema in a READ ONLY transaction; existing-schema compatibility entry also verifies without replay. Explicit initialization refuses existing business tables.

limits: Local working-tree acceptance; original unrelated changes are present.
No isolated/staged candidate acceptance and no production completeRelease.
Missing or incompatible production schema now blocks release and requires separate explicit maintenance.
Historical acceptance reports describe earlier code and are retained as evidence.
